verdict.rationale: Mastra documents that workflow steps can call agents, and its graph-based engine supports `.then()`, `.branch()` and `.parallel()`, so several agents can be sequenced, branched or run concurrently inside one workflow. The pack never documents agent-to-agent handoffs, supervisor/subagent delegation or crew-style collaboration, so multi-agent orchestration is only implied through workflow composition. Missing for 10: documented handoff or subagent/supervisor primitives, crew-style coordination, and any multi-agent example or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can orchestrate multiple agents — handoffs, subagents, or crews — inside one workflow

citations.quote: Workflow steps can call agents to use LLM reasoning or call tools for type-safe logic.
use Mastra's graph-based workflow engine to orchestrate complex multi-step processes. Mastra workflows use an intuitive syntax for control flow (`.then()`, `.branch()`, `.parallel()`).
